snippet.title: The BIGGEST UPDATE in Gartic Phone is here!
snippet.description:
Gartic Phone turned five a few months ago and… let’s just say we decided to refresh things.
Jokes aside, it felt like the right moment to give our beloved game a big update.
Here’s what’s new:
- new layout
- square canvas option
- frame exposure control
- drawing process replay
- custom settings improvements
- fixed settings
- QR code room sharing
- more shortcuts
- moderation updates
- new avatars

Aaaand that’s a wrap. 
We hope you enjoy the new features. Let us know what you think, and if you run into any issues, reach out at team@gartic.com

If you’d like to read more about it, please check out the article on Medium: https://medium.com/gartic/did-you-notice-gartic-phone-just-got-a-major-update-fba6a8d1dfc7 

#GarticPhone #GameUpdate #DrawingGames #gamedeveloper #partygame #onlinepartygame
